title: Reading Drill — Comparing footbridge materials — Building a comparison
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing footbridge materials — Building a comparison
passages.body:
**A** The bridge technician had been asked to investigate bridge surfaces becoming smooth after repeated use in Foxhaven. Its first task was to decide which signs of improvement could be compared between sites. It settled on surface grip, because the same measure could be applied in the original setting and at a second location.

**B** During a five-week comparison, the team used portable slip tests at both places. It recorded outcomes separately for each site. Because mud on footwear might influence the figures, the team used a column in the record to show when that condition was present. The surveys included quiet periods as well as busy ones.

**C** The team then put forward a textured deck coating. Its report asked for another comparison after the change had been tried. This would distinguish a genuine effect from an improvement that could have occurred anyway. The report did not assume that the more successful site before the change would be the better site afterwards.
